notes.title: Wishlist My New Game: WordScoop!
notes.content:
Introducing: WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter[previewyoutube="fxTCEa_lGEI;full"][/previewyoutube]


Hey, folks!



As of late, I've been finishing up a new game: WordScoop! With Gelato the Otter. The gameplay revolves around finding words hidden within a matrix of ice cream scoops, while trying to prevent creatures called VOIDs from reaching the bottom. 



WordScoop was actually developed as my senior thesis project in college! For the assignment, I wanted to challenge myself by making a sort of game I've never done before. 



If you've seen the trailer, you may have noticed that the game hearkens back to some of the downloadable computer games of the early 'oughts, albeit with its own spin! 



I would be honored if you put the game on your wishlist. I'm between jobs and planning to someday do GameDev full time, so your support means the world to me!



Link to Steam Page:
